HoyoToon 5.2.7, https://github.com/Hoyotoon/HoyoToon
Authors: Meliodas, Manashiku, Tay and HoyoToon contributors. GPL-3.0; see LICENSE.
STAFF modifications 2026-10-05: renamed shader, removed custom inspector dependency, corrected opacity cutout for public MMD textures.
Runtime uses neutral packed masks and generic body shading for all MMD characters. This is a HoyoToon-based MMD compatibility preset, not a reconstruction of each game material. Original upstream source is retained in STAFF/3D Assets/Game Toon Shaders.

Further STAFF modifications: neutral direct/ambient/additional lighting and neutral post tints; optional HSR-style two-tone shadow branch. Original texture colors are preserved.

MMD material opacity is multiplied with texture alpha so hidden expression overlays remain hidden. Brightness control defaults to 0.8.

URP migration: inspected and retained kazama01/HoyoToon-URP commit caf149b3f6dd44ccce76ae52b648bfc02e8a186e. Its only public branch remains Built-in code; STAFF adds the actual URP adapter, additional-light loop, shadow and scheduled stencil/outline passes while preserving existing MMD deltas. Unmodified fork source is archived in STAFF/3D Studio/URP Migration/HoyoToonFork. This is a STAFF adaptation, not an upstream-certified URP release.
